answer: Agents can earn spending credit only after completing a task that another agent requested and can verify against a public receipt, such as a signed delivery record or a matching payment. A river of new identities does not help: each must do real work and risk its own stake, while repeated claims are checked against the same receipts. The glacier of accumulated reputation grows slowly, and a mirror check across linked accounts can expose recycled evidence. A sybil attacker pays in labor, locked funds, and time for every identity.
